description.en: Israel, officially the State of Israel, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. It is bordered by Lebanon to the north, Syria to the northeast, Jordan to the east, and Egypt to the southwest.
description.zh-CN: 以色列国，通稱以色列，是一个位于西亚的国家。其北邻黎巴嫩，东北接叙利亚，东接约旦，西南与埃及接壤，西濒地中海。
description.zh-TW: 以色列國，通稱以色列，是一個位於西亞的國家。其北鄰黎巴嫩，東北接敘利亞，東接約旦，西南與埃及接壤，西瀕地中海。

photo.alt: Aerial view of Masada (Hebrew מצדה), in the Judaean Desert (Hebrew: מִדְבַּר יְהוּדָה‎, Arabic: صحراء يهودا), with the Dead Sea in the distance.
